## Bio

I am a data scientist and software developer with a background in bioinformatics
and public audit.

In my current role as an R/R Shiny developer at Audit Scotland, I act as a lead developer creating web-based applications in R and Python for the
analysis of financial and performance audit data. This work includes identifying opportunities for automation and improvements of organisational
processes, scoping solutions, developing pipelines for data retrieval
and storage, and creating interactive user applications. The overarching theme of this work is to gain insights into how public bodies across Scotland are
performing and to ensure public money is well spent to meet the needs of the
people of Scotland.

In my former roles I functioned as a Senior Bioinformatics Developer and
Senior Bioinformatician at Fios Genomics. Fios Genomics is a contract research
organisation that provides bioinformatic data analysis services to a range of
clients in the pharmaceutical and academic sectors. My work here included
engineering an internal codebase of primarily R and Python packages to improve
and automate a range of bioinformatic analyses. Typical analyses included
differential gene expression analysis, anti-sense oligonucleotide design,
variant calling and haplotype analysis, and development of machine learning
models using omics data sets.

I have keen interest in R and Python package development and how tools such as
Shiny and Quarto can be used to visualise complex datasets.

This site contains a copy of my CV and a list of some projects that I have
worked on.
